title: Get Shop Product Performance List
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /analytics/202605/shop_products/performance

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns a paginated list of shop products and their total, seller-channel, affiliate-channel, and Shop Tab performance metrics for the specified date range.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
start_date_ge string Y 2024-04-01 Start date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "ge" refers to "greater than or equal to" (inclusive)
end_date_lt string Y 2024-04-08 End date of the requested range in the shop's registered timezone, in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format. This date is exclusive and must be later than start_date_ge.
page_size int N 10 Number of products per page.
Max value: 100
Default value: 10
page_token string N cGFnZV9udW1iZXI9MQ== Page token, indicating the current position. Used for requesting next page data.
Leave this field empty for first time queries.
sort_field string N gmv Field to sort on.
Default: gmv
Available values:
  • gmv
  • items_sold
  • orders | sort_order |string |N |DESC |Sort direction. Available values: ASC, DESC Default value: DESC
  • ASC: ascending
  • DESC: descending | currency |string |N |LOCAL |Currency. Available values: USD, LOCAL Default value: LOCAL
  • USD: US dollars
  • LOCAL: local currency where the shop is located | category_filter |[]string |N |123123,321412 |Level 1 category IDs used to filter the returned shop product performance list. | product_status_filter |string |N |LIVE |Product status filter.

Available values:

  • LIVE: live products
  • INACTIVE: inactive products
  • ALL: all product statuses; this is the default |
